name: Move computer to OU
summary: Moves Active Directory computer objects to an OU chosen from the directory.
description: Moves the AD computer objects of one or more servers to an organizational unit browsed from the directory (Admin > Identity provider of type Active Directory). Runs over LDAP with a vault credential that has the right to move computer objects; no RSAT needed. Objects already in the OU are skipped; the previous OU of each object is reported so the move can be reverted.

inputs.name: ComputerNames
inputs.label: Computer names
inputs.help: One name per line (NetBIOS name or FQDN), max 200.

inputs.name: TargetOU
inputs.label: Target OU
inputs.help: OUs read from the directory (refreshed every 15 minutes).

inputs.name: DirectoryCredential
inputs.label: Directory credential
inputs.help: Account allowed to move computer objects between these OUs.
